verdict.rationale: Numeral's API creates a `calculation` object from an address and product set before recording a `transaction`, implying the calculation inputs (address, product, resulting tax) are persisted and linked to the transaction, and IP-based resolution is also supported. However, there is no explicit documentation of a full audit trail (jurisdiction rules applied, rate breakdown, resolution method) being retained and exportable for ops review — only that calculations feed transactions and transactions feed filings. Missing for 10: explicit calculation/audit record schema showing rate + rule citations, confirmation that historical calculations are retrievable/exportable long-term, and any audit-report or CSV/export feature for tax computations.
